description: Refpu aire implantation stationnement (point) is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Le référentiel des projets urbains (RefPU) est la version numérique des plans d'affectations produits par l'autorité compétente en matière d'aménagement du territoire du canton de Genève. Pour l'heure, seuls les plans localisés de quartier (PLQ) sont publiés dans ce référentiel. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 4 resource(s) in API, WFS, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
